incident: The first all-in-one execute call returned "WordPress API error (405)" (gateway timeout) but kept running server-side: it had drafted 12 of the 16 old posts before the new ones were published, so those URLs 404ed for roughly 10-15 minutes. Recovered by publishing in small batches (<=4 posts per call, ~3-10s per post), guarded and idempotent with the still-running request, whose target state is identical. Lesson: never put more than a few wp_update_post calls in one request on this host.
